connect_pybullet_server: connect to a pybullet physics server using SHARED_MEMORY or GUI mode
load_urdf_model: load a URDF robot model such as a quadruped into the pybullet simulation
start_state_logging: start Minitaur-format state logging for a robot body to a text file
step_simulation: step the pybullet physics simulation forward by one or more timesteps
stop_state_logging: stop the active Minitaur state logging session using its log ID
